title: montanoa tomentosa subsp. xanthiifolia
intro: Montanoa tomentosa subsp. xanthiifolia, commonly known as Mexican Gold or False Yarrow, is a type of flowering plant native to Mexico. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestive health, and supporting the immune system. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal agent, as well as its potential to reduce stress and anxiety. The bioactive constituents of Montanoa tomentosa subsp. xanthiifolia include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its various health benefits.
